div.div: مُطَّلِعٌ Strong, or powerful; high, or eminent; one who subdues, or overcomes: (K:) or strong, or powerful; as also مُضْطَلِعٌ: or the latter has this meaning, from الضَّلَاعَةُ; and the former signifies high, or eminent; one who subdues, or overcomes: (O:) accord. to ISk, one says, هُوَ مُضْطَلِعٌ بِحَمْلِهِ [“ he is one who has strength to bear it ”]; but not مُطَّلِعٌ بحمله. (TA.) [See, however, مُضْطَلِعٌ, in art. ضلع.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
